title: Paginate GET /books
body:
`GET /books` returns everything. Add pagination with `?page=` (1-based, default 1) and `?limit=` (default 20, max 50):

- the response body stays a JSON array (existing clients rely on that)
- add an `X-Total-Count` header with the total number of matching books
- invalid values (page < 1, limit < 1, non-numbers) return 400 with `{ error }`; a limit above 50 is clamped to 50
- a page past the end returns an empty array

The handler contract already supports returning `headers`.
plan:
Add server-side pagination to GET /books with query params page and limit, preserving JSON array responses and X-Total-Count header. Validate inputs and clamp limit to 50; return 400 with { error } on invalid values; return empty array when page exceeds data.
1. Implement pagination in GET /books handler
2. Validate and normalize query parameters (page, limit)

Limit greater than 50 is clamped to 50

The handler contract that returns { status, body, headers? } is respected
No changes to other endpoints or behavior unless required by pagination
